senses.example: In the meanwhile, the surveyors carried the line three miles, which was no contemptible day's work, considering how cruelly they were entangled with briers and gallbushes.

senses.definition: During the time that something is happening, often specifically in a different place.
senses.example: There was a party going on downstairs. Meanwhile, I was reading a book.

senses.definition: During an intervening time; from now until a future time.
senses.example: We’re going on holiday next month; meanwhile, keep working on the project.

senses.definition: In contrast to aspects previously mentioned.
senses.example: Some songs on the album are beautiful. Meanwhile, others are quite forgettable.
